package.name: vesc_dronecan_driver
package.description: Robot-agnostic ros2_control SystemInterface for VESC motor controllers over DroneCAN. Speaks uavcan.equipment.esc.{RPMCommand,Status} for driven joints and uavcan.equipment.actuator.{ArrayCommand,Status} for steered joints, directly over SocketCAN using a vendored copy of the same libcanard codec the VESC firmware uses. Per-ESC pack telemetry is exported as gpio state interfaces.
